profile: Static self-contained ASCII named v1 fragment; exact source Unicode comments preserved. Every source-supported constructor must elaborate; foreign or ambiguous constructs are explicitly TEXT_ONLY after bounded trusted parser/policy acceptance. Rendering submitted supported IR must elaborate back modulo declared equivalence; failure rejects candidate as correspondence failure. No parser acceptance alone grants IR authority.

signature_ref.ast: Sig identity; strip transparent NOOP only; reject built-in signatures

field_ref.ast: Sig.Field identity, optionally wrapped in parser-inserted owner DOMAIN restriction; require exact owning signature, single matching field and raw source token coverage without authored <:

variable_ref.ast: ExprVar identity resolved in explicit lexical stack; never resolve by label alone

predicate_call.ast: ExprCall.fun identity where isPred=true; ordered ExprCall.args; nonrecursive call graph

and.ast: ExprBinary.AND or ExprList.AND; flatten ordered same-op children then deterministic left fold

or.ast: ExprBinary.OR or ExprList.OR; flatten ordered same-op children then deterministic left fold

union.ast: ExprBinary.PLUS with relation operands; reject integer PLUS

difference.ast: ExprBinary.MINUS with relation operands; reject integer MINUS

join.ast: ExprBinary.JOIN; parser-generated field owner restriction checked by field_ref rule

product.ast: ExprBinary.ARROW with no arrow multiplicity operators

all_quant.ast: ExprQt.ALL; exactly one Decl/name, unary exact Sig domain after one/default-one wrapper; no disj/private/var

some_quant.ast: ExprQt.SOME with same single-atom binder rule

declarations.signature: Top-level primitive nonabstract static signature; multiplicity set/one/lone/some; no extends/in, enum, builtins, privacy or signature-body facts. Each ordered declaration has one globally unique profile name; multiple-name shorthand not part of v1. Print set multiplicity as sig, others explicit. Fields nested in owning signature declaration.
declarations.field: Single field name; fullschema owner::range derived from stable declaration IDs. Unary range set/one/lone/some; tuple range only set of plain product signature refs. Default unary source multiplicity means one; explicit set tuple print uses parentheses. No disjoint/var/private/arrow multiplicity. Use Field.decl and ownership, not type string.
declarations.predicate: Named pred with ordered single-name parameters. Each parameter explicitly set-valued plain product of declared signatures; zero parameters allowed. Func.isPred true; body read from Func.getBody before expansion. Reject functions/return values/recursion and profile-shadowed names.
declarations.fact_assertion: Explicit unique named fact/assert; body formula from original declarations. Empty braces or implicit conjunction block shorthand outside v1 unless exact token/AST reconstruction yields documented and-fold; no invented truth constant. Compiler-inserted global facts never become authored roots.
declarations.commands: Only explicitly authored run namedNullaryPredicate/check namedAssertion, bounded uniform scope1..5, bitwidth4,maxseq3; printer emits for N but 4 Int, 3 seq. Parse authored target token using bounded lexer and resolve exact declaration ID; cross-check parser Command.check/options. Never use expanded Command.formula as body/target oracle. No inline formula, per-sig scopes, temporal expectations or synthetic default run enters block module. Source with no authored commands has empty list even if Alloy synthesizes default command.

elaboration.identity: Build exact parser-object to stable-ID maps in source declaration order. Names identify syntax declarations once, then all semantic references use object identity and lexical stack. Validate globally unique allowed names; unsupported name/shadowing patterns yield TEXT_ONLY. Generated source keeps user display names; anonymous canonical pipeline remains separate.
elaboration.schema: Derive exact ordered nominal schema from closed references/operators independently of Alloy Type. Parser acceptance is additionally required. Parser type may represent empty relation after simplification; never substitute empty/alternative schema for the independently derived schema. If resolved object/type indicates a conflicting declaration, arity or owner, mark correspondence unavailable/reject generated block; do not cast type strings.
elaboration.normalization: Only transparent ExprUnary.NOOP, parentheses, parser-inserted single-field owner restriction with exact rawtoken evidence, and ordered associative and/or flattening are erased. No arbitrary domain/range restrictions, relation simplification, commutation, command expansion, quantifier merging, let, integer or temporal rewrite. Deterministic left fold establishes a representation for normalized and/or source; round-trip compares flattened ordered lists.
elaboration.source_tokens: Bounded lexical pass over exact source records token/comment byte and UTF16 intervals. Recognize strings/escapes/comments before identifiers/operators, so comment text cannot invent declaration/command tokens. Cross-check AST source interval/token coverage. Authored <: is unsupported even when resolved AST resembles inserted field qualification. Qualified X.r is a join and preserves that distinction. Module names/imports/unsupported top-level syntax prevent block support.
elaboration.occurrences: Maps are optional per role; unavailable parser positions omit that entry with bounded projection diagnostic. Accepted block requires validated fullIR and artifact-bound map collection, not a guessed total location map. Empty collection valid for empty module. Printer records exact intervals directly, subject to scalar boundaries; source elaborator verifies pinned file-parser coordinate conversion and token match. Missing spans never disable independent typing.
elaboration.history: Revalidation of historical content preserves exact source/IR/map content and creates fresh policy/parser report/artifact identity. If current adapters cannot validate unchanged content, reject history-copy; no silent reinterpretation or historical mutation.

finite_acceptance_matrix: For each23tag, concrete positive and negative Typed witness, Java checker and browser preview result; finite fixtures are not universal infer correctness.

Generated parse(print(IR)) and source elaborate for all tags/declarations, zero/multiple commands, nested scope/calls, tuple fields/params, precedence/and-or associativity and unknown syntax; independent alpha-ID bijection.
SAT4J fixtures for per-owner one/lone/some unary field cardinality, arbitrary tuple-set field, set-valued tuple arguments including empty/nonempty, swappedcolumns/wrongarity/type denials.

Same-looking refs/different binders/fieldowners, unbound/capturedvariable, recursive dependencies, equality/subset direction, joins/products bounds and empty runtime relation with valid nominal schema.
Exact file-parser CRLF/LF/tabs/EOF, supplementary/combining characters, strings/comments, unavailable spans and immutable source hash.

Actual existing BubblewrapLauncher resource caps, timeout/reap/outputs/concurrency, and SQLeanParser catalog of every DDL/transaction/RLS/recovery statement. Any deniedSQL blocks feature; no directPostgresfallback or unreviewedgatewaychange.
trust: Alloy parsing, solver correctness, lexical/AST adapter, Java/TS/SQL refinement remain explicit trusted components plus finite differential/integration tests. Contracts do not assert these tests already passed.
commercial: Local engineering only; no dataset redistribution or production commercialization clearance.
